tested_boundaries: Baseline preferred is blue; regression and risk have distinct explicit labels
Required unmeasured, unknown, measured and reviewed not-applicable metric states remain distinct
Not-applicable declarations require a reason and named accepted review and cannot contradict decision checks
Frozen nonoverlapping whole-family scopes retain all planned cases and declared evidence minima
Post-hoc changes under an old lock and shared provenance failures block local support
Unrelated missing or negative outcomes remain in the full report without erasing eligible local scope evidence
Full-study cost allocations are retained without dropping shared setup expenditure
Scoped two-direction decision-error ceilings are recomputed using original observations
Synthetic data cannot establish supported use
Diagnose and usage-card produce identical cards with the same cost ledger, including unknown costs
Malformed cost-ledger input fails rather than silently omitting costs
limitations: Regression observations and browser examples are manufactured fixtures.
Frozen declarations provide local tamper detection, not independently authenticated preregistration.
Named metric reviews are declarations, not authenticated independent review.
Scope guidance remains descriptive and bound to its declared cases and conditions; it does not imply general benefit.
Full-suite validation preceded the final presentation-only changes; all 52 usage tests were rerun on the final presentation.
